metadata.name: Codex App
metadata.description: Complete work with official Codex, organized by local folders

metadataV2.tagline: Delegate work to official Codex with clear file context
metadataV2.longDescription: An official Codex client for everyday work and coding tasks. Organize tasks by local folder, sign in with a ChatGPT subscription, and use approvals, Skills, usage information, and file changes. Code and text editing are handled by the separate text editor plugin.
metadataV2.capability0Detail: Use your ChatGPT subscription; credentials are managed only by the official local Codex runtime
metadataV2.capability1Detail: Tasks are grouped by the local folders you choose
metadataV2.capability2Detail: View or edit through the text editor plugin; no built-in IDE
metadataV2.caption0: Organize Codex tasks by working folder
metadataV2.caption1: Conversations, approvals, and file changes in one task
